systems.country_label: national platform for the security and digitalization of justice documents (e-justice.ci)
systems.tiers: pilot in the jurisdictions of Dabou and Yopougon in 2025, nationwide deployment planned; nationality certificates online, criminal records to follow

note: The passages cover the justice ministry's document platform and say the country lacks a nationwide electronic justice system, with paper records held locally; the gendarmerie appears only as the programme's security contact. Nothing on police or gendarmerie station records.
